## About me

Hi, I'm Sanskar Bachani. I'm a junior at Claremont McKenna College. I like working with data. I made this site for my Foundations of Data Science in R class.

This site has two plots made with TidyTuesday data. You can find the [code for this site on GitHub](https://github.com/sbachani28/portfolio).

## Data Viz

### [Olympic Basketball](basketball.qmd)

How did player ages differ across men's basketball teams in 2016?

### [Movie Budgets](movies.qmd)

Do films with bigger budgets earn more at the box office?

Each page includes the R code for its plot.
